prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a polished, inventive high-fidelity UI design concept for MaiPace, a Vietnamese personal Japanese N5 learning app. This is a proposed interface, not advertising or a photograph. Real interface copy in Vietnamese, learning content Japanese. Design mobile-first. Render crisp perfectly legible Vietnamese diacritics and Japanese glyphs. All Japanese in a modern Noto Sans JP style, UI in Inter-style sans serif. Existing Washi semantic colors: background warm near-white paper, foreground deep charcoal ink, card white, muted pale warm gray, primary torii red, primary-foreground light paper. No hex labels or new palette. Status colors reserved for genuine status with icon plus text. Brand shown only as exact wordmark "MaiPace"; do not invent a new logo. Product scope: 25 N5 lessons, vocabulary, grammar, listening, practice, scheduled review, lookup. No leaderboard, coins, streak punishment, AI chat, locked levels, N4 contents or invented features. Illustration is ornamental and never a clickable learning node unless explicitly labeled. One red filled primary action per phone screen. Bottom nav on overview/lesson has exactly five clearly labeled targets "Bảng tin", "Học bài", "Luyện tập", "Ôn tập", "Tra cứu". Profile accessible in header. Practice hides bottom navigation and account header. Controls thumb reachable, minimum 48px logical touch targets, ruby furigana above kanji, no bracket notation printed. Mock quantities are sample data. No enormous marketing headline, no promotional prose, no device tilt, no photographic desk props, no watermark. Flat UI with natural hierarchy and purposeful illustration, highly finished designer craft.
Output a wide design board containing THREE separate complete portrait app viewports, equal width and height, roughly 390x844 logical pixels each, arranged left to right with narrow neutral gutters. A small label above each outside the viewport: "Bảng tin", "Bài học", "Làm bài". Board title "01 / PHỐ GIẤY". Camera is perfectly front-on orthographic; no phone chassis, no notch. Every viewport visible to its bottom; large readable text; not a grid of tiny thumbnails.
Direction: PLAYFUL JAPANESE PAPER TOWN. Mature but joyful papercut / risograph illustration, carefully composed little Japanese neighborhood in cream paper layers with charcoal linework, tiny people, shop awnings, plants, bicycle. This is the illustration style and visual metaphor, not a literal geographic map. Distinctive scalloped illustrated horizon confined to artwork. Main UI text is flat crisp semantic-looking text above or below artwork, never written on complex drawing. Make the first viewport feel like a charming useful learning journal, not a generic rounded-card dashboard.
LEFT dashboard: compact MaiPace wordmark header and account icon, greeting "Chào buổi sáng". A generous but height-limited paper neighborhood illustration (about 22% viewport) organically joins an open, borderless priority section "Hôm nay ôn một chút" with "12 mục đến hạn · khoảng 3 phút". Large filled red thumb-readable button "Bắt đầu ôn". Directly below, a compact plain row "Tiếp tục phiên" / "Bài 1 · từ 4/10" with arrow. Then a horizontal illustrated lesson slip "Bài 1" / "Giới thiệu bản thân", small neutral progress label "Đã vào lịch ôn 23/41", outline button "Vào bài học". A discreet ink label "Lưu trên máy". Bottom nav fits without covering any rows; selected Bảng tin uses red ink and thin underline, no second red filled component.
MIDDLE lesson hub: back control; "BÀI 01", "Giới thiệu bản thân", large Japanese "はじめまして". One tasteful illustrated scene of two people bowing, ink and cream, not a giant mascot. Primary red action "Học từ vựng". Below, tidy open ruled list with icons and arrows "Ngữ pháp", "Nghe", "Xem toàn bộ bài"; secondary outline "Luyện Bài 1". A visible vocabulary sample "私" with furigana "わたし", meaning "tôi". Keep navigation and breathing room.
RIGHT practice focus: no account and no dock; top "Lưu và thoát" and "4 / 10" plus a thin neutral segmented progress bar, tiny paper crane decoration at the edge only. Title "Chọn nghĩa đúng". Huge Japanese 学生 with ruby がくせい, occupies central focus. Four full-width neutral answer rows "học sinh / sinh viên", "giáo viên", "bác sĩ", "nhân viên công ty"; first answer selected with pale accent wash, red outline and check, not solid red. Red button fixed above safe area "Kiểm tra". Minimal ink supporting text, no timers or distractions.

Direction: ILLUSTRATED JAPANESE LOCAL RAIL JOURNEY, cheerful friendly ink illustrations with paper-white and charcoal, playful little train, station kiosk, luggage tag shapes. The journey is a metaphor for browsing existing lessons; no reward game. Much more geometric and rhythmic than a paper-town design: large lesson numbers, vertical timetable rails and station-sign typography, ticket-like flat sections with small perforation hints. No dense dashboard cards. This should look like a distinctive illustrated travel journal adapted to studying.
LEFT dashboard: compact MaiPace header/account, greeting "Một chút tiếng Nhật hôm nay". A horizontal charming charcoal-and-paper local train illustration traverses upper 20% only. Below it, a bold flat ticket-shaped priority area on white with open strong typography "Ôn trước, học tiếp" / "12 mục đến hạn · khoảng 3 phút". One red filled CTA "Bắt đầu ôn". Directly under CTA a very clear compact ticket row "Tiếp tục phiên · Bài 1 · từ 4/10" with arrow. Below a ruled timetable row "Bài đang học" / "01 Giới thiệu bản thân" / "Đã vào lịch ôn 23/41", outline "Vào bài học". Small "Lưu trên máy" and fixed five-item dock; selected state via ink/underline only.
MIDDLE actual lesson LIST screen: MaiPace header, title "Học bài", filter chips "Tất cả", "Đang học", "Chưa học", clearly labeled "Lọc bài học". Main content a usable vertical timetable rail with generous numbered stations down one side, each lesson on a clean row. Current lesson "01 Giới thiệu bản thân" / "はじめまして", small 23/41 progress label and sole red filled "Tiếp tục học". Two more visible rows "02 Đồ vật xung quanh" and "03 Nơi chốn", neutral outlines, no locks. Every lesson is accessible regardless of prior progress. Tiny train illustration parked beside current station; illustration never hides label. Plain bottom link "Xem đủ 25 bài". Fixed five-item dock.
RIGHT focused reorder practice: top "Lưu và thoát", "4 / 10". "Sắp xếp câu" then meaning "Tôi là sinh viên." A wide empty answer lane built like a clean ticket slot, with visible placed token "私は"; below neutral large draggable/tappable tokens "学生", "です" and "私は" as appropriate available/placed state (do not duplicate selectable placed token; place two remaining tokens below). Japanese ruby above 私 (わたし) and 学生 (がくせい). Very subtle rail baseline decoration, never a background behind text. Large flat red "Kiểm tra" button bottom, secondary "Làm lại" text. No main dock, no confetti, no countdown.
prompts.edit_prompt: Edit this MaiPace three-screen UI concept board, preserving its train-journey illustration style, typography, composition, Vietnamese copy, Japanese furigana and all other controls. Make ONLY these corrections: on LEFT screen bottom local-storage row delete the small sentence "Tải bài học để học ngoại tuyến" completely. Keep only "Lưu trên máy", replace the download arrow with a simple neutral outlined database icon. Do not promise downloadable/offline reload functionality. On MIDDLE screen selected filter "Tất cả" should be pale warm-gray fill and dark ink, not solid red; current station number 01 should be a white circle with red outline and red numerals, not red fill; keep the red primary button "Tiếp tục học". On RIGHT screen remove the large train/station scenery below the answer tokens and replace that area with calm warm paper whitespace plus a tiny charcoal train line illustration at its edge at most 40 logical pixels tall, so the Japanese phrase tokens and red "Kiểm tra" remain the focus. Preserve screen heights, bottom controls and all legible text. Render no new copy or new UI features.

Beautiful restrained pencil/linocut drawings of open Japanese workbook, ceramic tea cup, pencil, small origami bird, paper tabs and plants. Flat paper-white UI, charcoal ink, warm gray dividers and torii-red for primary CTA only. Oversized Japanese type and asymmetric open composition, carefully aligned controls. Illustrations feel hand-drawn and charming but do not make interface objects tilted or controls look like physical objects. No colorful sticker clutter, no drop-shadow stacks.
LEFT dashboard: MaiPace header and account, "Chào buổi sáng". Open typographic layout with a modest hand-drawn still life of open workbook and tea on the upper right (at most 20% screen), ample blank left area. Heading "Góc học của bạn". Quiet prompt "Bạn nhớ nghĩa của từ này không?". Sole red filled bottom CTA "Hiện nghĩa". No four rating buttons before reveal, no answer correctness colors, no timers. Discreet "Lưu trên máy" neutral ink state. Main word and primary CTA visually dominate.

RIGHT vocabulary front screen: remove the entire student person and school illustration, replacing the region with mostly clean paper whitespace and a small charming drawing of a tea cup and origami crane, at most one-quarter the old illustration area, without any people, books, school or content that suggests the hidden meaning of 学生. RIGHT screen bottom "Lưu trên máy" also replace download symbol with neutral database symbol. No new text, features or ratings. All Vietnamese diacritics and Japanese must remain crisp.
